description: A row whose hidden actions are revealed by swiping to the side; a full swipe performs the action itself.
interactionNotes: Drag the row to the side to bring the actions out from the edge. If you pull too little it springs back; if you pass the threshold it stays there. Pull all the way and release to run the action directly. With a keyboard, the arrow keys open and close the row.

props.children: The content of the row itself.
props.actions: The actions that come out when you swipe.
props.drawerColor: Color of the drawer, beneath the row.
props.direction: The direction the row moves as it opens; the drawer comes out from the opposite edge.
props.snapBounce: Spring bounce when it snaps into place.
props.collapseMs: Duration of the collapse after an action runs.
props.commitAt: From what percentage of the width a drag counts as a full swipe.
props.fullSwipe: Whether a full swipe runs the action directly.
props.onOpenChange: Called when the row opens or closes.
props.onCommit: Called after the swipe completes; the moment the action is committed.
props.onAction: A simpler version of `onCommit`; for when only the result matters.
props.autoPreview: Rows open and close one after another by themselves; for a showcase card.
props.closeOnAction: Whether the row closes itself after an action is chosen.
props.haptic: A short vibration on touch devices at the moment the swipe commits.
props.label: The default row text, when you have not passed anything to `rows`.

tips: The first action in the list is the primary one — the one a full swipe runs. The rest are laid out after it.
With `dismiss` on an action, that one also collapses the row; without it, the drawer only closes.
The texts are Persian and the rest of the behavior is the default — including the `direction` default, which brings the drawer out from the right.
`onCommit` is called after the collapse animation finishes — if you change the list right there, the user will not see a jump.
